name: Da Lat Market
kicker: Flower and produce halls above the lake
summary: Climb the sloping halls above Xuan Huong Lake for flowers, strawberries, and the counters of jam, dried fruit, and artichoke tea. Come in the morning for produce, allow about an hour, then walk back down to the water.
getThere: Walk uphill from Xuan Huong Lake
heroCaption: Night stalls on the market slope
body: Walk up from the lake into the sloping halls. Morning is produce, flowers, and a cup of strawberries with condensed milk. Avocado ice cream is the cold snack at the counters.

Give the halls about an hour. Around the edge, counters sell fruit preserves, candied ginger, coffee, and artichoke tea to take home. After dark the night market in the centre takes over, from about 18:00 to 23:00, with grilled rice paper and hot soy milk.

figures.caption: Flower stalls inside the market hall
figures.alt: Rows of cut flowers for sale inside Da Lat Market

gettingThere: The market sits on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake. Walk up from the shore.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: On foot, a short walk up the slope.

admissionNote: Free to enter. Stall prices, the street address, and opening hours are Check on arrival. Night market: about 18:00–23:00 (Visit Lâm Đồng).
